title: AI reads the Buga Sphere symbols as 'The circuit'

tellings.quote: Um but I did what I'm increasingly doing these days. I took a photograph of the sphere, and I uploaded it to AI.

plain: The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart says that in 2025 he photographed the Buga Sphere, a metal ball with strange symbols on it that turned up in Buga, Colombia, and uploaded the picture to an AI program, which read the symbols as meaning "the circuit". He tells Michels he is "increasingly" doing this with such images; if the reading held, it would hint that the markings describe how the object works.
